prompt: Origin: own procedural render, not generated by an image model and not a photograph. tools/heat-tint.py builds a height field of a ground stainless plate with a TIG weld bead, lights it with a straw key and a temper-blue rim, colours the oxide by thickness (blue and purple at the bead, bronze, gold and straw further out) and adds perspective, shallow depth of field and grain. Shows the temper colours the site's palette is named after.
